notes.title: 🔴 Regarding the Violence, Ending, and My Intentions as Developer
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]So… a few folks have been shocked by the game. That’s fair. It’s not exactly a cozy walk through a haunted forest with spooky whispers and candles. It’s dark, it’s brutal, and yeah, [b]you play as the villain[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Some players have called me a “[i]psycho[/i]” for making it. Others were disturbed that the bad guy gets away in the end.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s clear the air:[/p][p]🔧 [b]This game is fiction.[/b]
I’m not the character. I don’t own a power drill (unless IKEA counts). I’m a solo dev who wanted to make something [i]intentionally messed up[/i], because that’s what horror is supposed to do: [b]get under your skin[/b], not tuck you in at night.[/p][p][/p][p]even though... I find it edgy as well, and it was intentional.[/p][p][/p][p]🎬 [b]You saw the trailer.[/b][/p][p]It didn’t lie. No one sold this as a feel-good redemption arc. You knew what you were walking into... and if you didn’t, welcome to horror that actually bites.[/p][p][/p][p]🔚 [b]The villain escapes.[/b][/p][p]Yeah. Because sometimes, in real life, evil slips away. I didn’t make this for people who need moral closure at the end. I made it for people who want to stare into the dark and walk away a little shaken.[/p][p][/p][p]📝 [b]One more thing:[/b][/p][p]Let’s separate the art from the artist.[/p][p]You don’t know me in real life... and calling me a psycho over a fictional story isn’t just unfair, it’s also not something anyone wants to hear. I get that the game’s disturbing, but that doesn’t mean that I am.[/p][p][/p][p]If it made you uncomfortable, good.
If you hated it, fair.
[/p][p]Thanks for playing it, appreciate it![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

[i]Once your assessment is completed, you'll be plunged deeper into the twisted world of a psychopath.[/i]
